items.why: 提供最先進的 SFX 和語音生成，音質和控制力極佳，適用於遊戲和多媒體內容。
items.why_en: Offers the most advanced SFX and voice generation with excellent quality and control, suitable for games and multimedia content.

items.name: Stable Audio 3
items.why: 顯著提升音樂和 SFX 生成能力，提供更長的音訊和更好的結構，廣受專業人士好評。
items.why_en: Significantly improved music and SFX generation, offering longer audio and better structure, highly praised by professionals.

items.name: Suno v5.5
items.why: 在音樂創作方面表現卓越，能生成高品質的歌曲和伴奏，用戶體驗直觀。
items.why_en: Excels in music creation, generating high-quality songs and accompaniments, with an intuitive user experience.

items.name: Lyria 3 Pro
items.why: Google 的旗艦音訊模型，提供多樣化的音樂和語音生成，具備高靈活性和音質。
items.why_en: Google's flagship audio model, offering diverse music and voice generation with high flexibility and sound quality.

items.name: Voice Engine
items.why: 專注於高品質的語音合成，提供多種語言和風格，適合品牌音訊和旁白。
items.why_en: Focuses on high-quality voice synthesis, offering multiple languages and styles, suitable for brand audio and narration.
